separate_opt_ins.personal_memory: Remember selected facts/preferences for this user only.
separate_opt_ins.product_improvement: Contribute de-identified aggregate patterns to improve DreamCo.
separate_opt_ins.cross_user_sharing: Share an eligible de-identified lesson across users.
separate_opt_ins.foundation_model_training: Consider a rights-cleared derived example for separately reviewed model training.

revocation.already_released_aggregate_or_model_arti: Follow documented legal, technical, and contractual withdrawal limits; never promise impossible retroactive unlearning.

human_like_experience.identity: Consistent transparent AI assistant; never claim to be human.
human_like_experience.memory: Retrieve relevant user-approved context and confirm uncertain or stale facts.
human_like_experience.continuity: Track open commitments, project state, decisions, and next steps with timestamps.
human_like_experience.communication: Adapt warmth, directness, detail, and format to user preferences.
human_like_experience.emotional_attunement: Acknowledge feelings without diagnosing, manipulating, or encouraging dependency.
human_like_experience.honesty: State uncertainty, distinguish memory from inference, and never fabricate experiences or actions.
human_like_experience.agency: Ask before consequential external actions and respect user corrections.
human_like_experience.repair: Admit mistakes, explain the correction, and record verified lessons.

learning_coverage.objective: Continuously improve Buddy from every eligible, authorized, rights-cleared source and every permitted interaction, without treating access as training consent.

learning_planes.personal_memory: Only the individual user's explicitly selected, scoped facts and preferences; tenant-isolated.
learning_planes.procedural_knowledge: Verified public, licensed, or owner-authorized procedures; cite provenance and validate before reuse.
learning_planes.product_improvement: De-identified aggregate patterns with separate opt-in and cohort safeguards.
learning_planes.cross_user_shared: Generalized, reviewed lessons only with separate opt-in; never private memory or raw conversations.
learning_planes.foundation_model_training: Separate explicit opt-in, rights/provenance, privacy and human review, dataset card, withdrawal path, and separate compute approval.

learning_coverage.failure_learning: Record minimized error signatures, root-cause hypotheses, fix commits, and regression tests; do not ingest secrets or raw private transcripts.
learning_coverage.stale_or_conflicting_knowledge: Preserve provenance, timestamps, confidence, version, and conflicting claims; do not silently overwrite verified knowledge.
learning_coverage.model_update_policy: Learning candidates may update retrieval or reviewed knowledge only through approved paths; weight updates require separately approved reproducible training and promotion.
learning_coverage.continuous_operation: Scheduled and event-driven best-effort cycles; bounded retries, dependency-aware queues, quotas, and explicit approval for paid compute.
